comparisons.peer_topic: Q1 2024 Goodwill Impairment for Intel Foundry
comparisons.peer_summary: Following a segment reporting modification in Q1 2024, Intel recognized a $222 million goodwill impairment loss for the Intel Foundry reporting unit, resulting in zero remaining goodwill for that unit. The impairment occurred because the fair value of the new reporting unit, which included substantially all allocated property, plant, and equipment, was lower than its carrying value.
comparisons.comparison: Unlike NVDA, which reported no goodwill impairment, INTC recognized a $222 million goodwill impairment loss in Q1 2024 for its Intel Foundry reporting unit following a business reorganization. NVDA stated, 'we completed our annual qualitative impairment tests and concluded that goodwill was not impaired,' whereas INTC disclosed, 'we recognized a non-cash goodwill impairment loss of $222 million... related to our Intel Foundry reporting unit, as the estimated fair value of the new reporting unit was lower than the assigned carrying value.'
